note: size_m is [x, y, z] in glTF axes (y up), metres, as imported in Godot. file is relative to the assets/ directory. sounds lists the audio files used by godot/shooter (data/sounds.json maps events to them); they are not placeable objects and are not loaded by assets-check. unverified_models lists user-provided files whose source page and licence are NOT confirmed: they are not placeable assets, are not in packs/assets (which are CC0 only, checked by the pipeline tests), and must not ship until the licence and attribution are confirmed.
